# Overview

OpenRouter is a unified interface for LLMs. It provides a single API for all major language models, with a focus on standardization, reliability, and cost-effectiveness.

## Key Features

- **Unified API**: Access hundreds of models through a single OpenAI-compatible endpoint.
- **Cost Optimization**: Automatic routing to the cheapest provider for a given model.
- **High Availability**: Fallback mechanisms ensure your requests succeed even if a specific provider is down.
- **Real-time Analytics**: Monitor your usage and costs across all models and providers.

## Getting Started

Check out the [Quickstart](/docs/openrouter_docs/General/Quickstart.md) to begin integrating OpenRouter into your application.
